issue.title: Commands hang waiting for stdin when executed via `LocalShellBackend`
issue.body: ### Checked other resources - [x] This is a bug, not a usage question. - [x] I added a clear and descriptive title. - [x] I searched existing issues and didn't find this. - [x] I can reproduce this with the latest released version. - [x] I included a minimal reproducible example and steps to reproduce. ### Area (Required) - [x] deepagents (SDK) - [ ] cli ### Related Issues / PRs _No response_ ### Reproduction Steps / Example Code (Python) ```python 1. Open `deepagents-cli` 2. Enter the prompt `run python` 3. The command hangs until timeout (e.g., 120 seconds) instead of exiting immediately (Check out the screenshot in the "Errror Message") ``` ### Error Message and Stack Trace (if applicable) ### Description #### Problem When running commands that require stdin input (e.g., python, cat, read, etc.) through the LocalShellBackend.execute() method without providing stdin, these commands hang indefinitely waiting for input. This causes the command to wait until the timeout is reached, which is inefficient and inconsistent with the expected behavior. This issue manifests in `deepagents-cli` when executing shell commands through the local shell backend. #### Expected behavior Similar to Claude Code, when a command is started non-interactively in the background without a terminal, it should exit immediately if no input is provided, rather than hanging until timeout. #### Proposed fix Add `stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL` to the `subprocess.run()` call in `LocalShellBackend.execute()` to prevent the command from waiting for stdin input: ``` result = subprocess.run( command, check=False, shell=True, capture_output=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, # No stdin interaction text=True, timeout=effective_timeout, env=self._env, cwd=str(self.cwd), ) ``` This ensures that interactive commands exit immediately instead of waiting for stdin, making the behavior consistent with Claude Code and other non-interactive shell execution environments. ### Environment / System Info _No response_

expected: A noninteractive Python invocation with no supplied stdin receives EOF rather than waiting indefinitely.
defect: LocalShellBackend leaves stdin attached and the command waits until its timeout.

fault location.explanation: LocalShellBackend.execute calls subprocess.run without stdin=DEVNULL. The child inherits an open input stream and an interactive reader can wait for input. #2427 closes stdin explicitly.

Root cause: LocalShellBackend.execute calls subprocess.run without stdin=DEVNULL. The child inherits an open input stream and an interactive reader can wait for input. #2427 closes stdin explicitly.
